draft.body:
It has been a while since we met at that orientation, I still think back on that conversation. Hope things at D3 have been treating you well since then.

I saw D3 has an opening for a Computer Vision and Deep Learning Engineer and thought of you right away. Over the past couple years I have been building and deploying computer vision models on embedded and edge hardware, most recently a voice controlled robotic arm that runs a real time object detector on an NVIDIA Jetson, plus segmentation and GPU kernel work during my masters at RIT. It felt like a strong match for what your team is probably looking for.

Would you be open to referring me for the role or pointing me to whoever owns that hiring process? Either way I would love to catch up properly sometime.
draft.hook_used: Met in person at an orientation in 2025; she responded warmly and said to stay in touch

meta.role: Computer Vision and Deep Learning Engineer
